scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @receptionist/api" "npm run dev -w @receptionist/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @receptionist/api && npm run build -w @receptionist/web
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run integrations:check && npm run build -w @receptionist/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @receptionist/api && npm run typecheck -w @receptionist/web
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
